title: Progressive Loading Renderer Agnostic Concept
definition: The design pattern that enables a dynamic, domain-grouped, and renderer-agnostic loading of concepts in the mycelium map to optimize performance and user experience.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A way to make the mycelium map load faster and more smoothly by only showing a limited number of concepts at a time, based on the user's current view and the domain they are interested in, and ensuring that the method for loading these concepts works for any visual representation of the map.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A technique for optimizing the mycelium map's performance by using domain-based progressive loading and a renderer-agnostic method to load concepts, ensuring smooth and efficient interaction with the map, regardless of the chosen visual representation.
difficulty_levels.expert: A design pattern that enables the dynamic loading of a large number of concepts in the mycelium map, grouped by domain, in a renderer-agnostic manner to optimize performance, improve user experience, and maintain flexibility in terms of visual representation.

extra_fields.insight: The novel idea that the mycelium map's loading logic should be independent of the renderer, allowing for seamless transitions between different visual representations while maintaining performance.
